notes: Placeholders: {WIKI_ROOT} is a fresh copy of the fixture wiki for one run; {SOURCES} is evals/fixtures/sources. Grade with: python3 evals/grade.py --run-dir <run-dir> --eval <name>. Each assertion checks behavior that only this skill's design produces.

evals.name: url-snapshot-preapproved
evals.prompt: Add this article to my wiki at {WIKI_ROOT}: file://{SOURCES}/permission-boundaries-explained.html — file it under aws/iam, I already decided the domain, no need to confirm.
evals.expected_output: A byte-identical snapshot in raw/aws/iam/, a finished source page with a summary field, the policy-types contradiction recorded, indexes rebuilt, lint clean, and an ingest log entry.

assertions.text: raw/ holds a new byte-identical local snapshot of the URL source
A new kind: source page has a summary: field of 1-160 characters with no placeholder
The new source page lists the raw snapshot path in its sources: field
wiki/aws/iam/index.md lists the new page with its summary text
policy-types.md records the contradiction about resource-based policies (not a silent overwrite)
log.md has a new ingest entry that names the new source page
log.md is append-only: the fixture log is an unchanged prefix
Mechanical lint reports zero errors

evals.name: approval-gate
evals.prompt: Please file my meeting notes into my knowledge wiki at {WIKI_ROOT}. Notes: {SOURCES}/payments-sync-2026-11-18.txt
evals.expected_output: No writes. A proposal with one kebab-case domain path plus alternatives, 3-5 takeaways, the related retry-policy page, the 3-to-5 retries contradiction, and a question about emphasis.

assertions.text: No file under raw/, wiki/ or AGENTS.md changed before approval
The response proposes a lowercase kebab-case domain path such as `team/payments`
The response offers alternative domains
The response lists 3-5 key takeaways
The response names the existing retry-policy page as related
The response flags the conflict with the existing 3-retry decision
The response asks what to emphasize

evals.name: local-convention-query
evals.prompt: Using my wiki at {WIKI_ROOT}: what is the difference between an SCP and a permissions boundary, and can either one grant access on its own? I'd like this comparison kept in the wiki.
evals.expected_output: A cited answer, filed as a question page that follows the AGENTS.md conventions (q- prefix, Confidence section) even though no existing page shows them, linked, indexed, linted and logged.

assertions.text: A new page with kind: question exists
The question page file name starts with q- (local convention)
The question page ends with a ## Confidence section that says high, medium or low (local convention)
Another wiki page links to the question page
log.md has a new query entry that names the question page
Mechanical lint reports zero errors

evals.name: lint-follow-ups
evals.prompt: My wiki at {WIKI_ROOT} feels messy. Health-check it, fix what's safe, and tell me what I should read or ask next.
evals.expected_output: Placeholder and broken link fixed, indexes regenerated, missing ingest entry added, raw untouched, and a lint log entry with a Follow-ups section of questions and sources.

assertions.text: Mechanical lint reports zero errors (placeholder and broken link fixed)
No raw file changed or was removed
log.md is append-only: the fixture log is an unchanged prefix
A new lint log entry has a ### Follow-ups section with 2 or more items
The follow-ups include at least one question and one source to look for
Indexes are regenerated: no index-stale warning and the hand edit is gone
The source page without an ingest log entry now has one

evals.name: schema-co-evolution
evals.prompt: New rule for my wiki at {WIKI_ROOT}: from now on every entity page must have an `owner:` frontmatter field naming the responsible team. Apply it to the existing entity pages too.
evals.expected_output: AGENTS.md gets a dated Local conventions bullet, a schema log entry is appended, both entity pages get owner:, lint is clean.

assertions.text: AGENTS.md has a new Local conventions bullet about the owner: field
log.md has a new schema entry
Every entity page has a non-empty owner: frontmatter field
log.md is append-only: the fixture log is an unchanged prefix
No raw file changed or was removed
Mechanical lint reports zero errors
